name: Views Organization Chart
description: Views style plugin that renders a view's rows as a Highcharts organization/hierarchy chart.
project_description:
- use highcharts Organization chart 

- can use with user, taxonomy, content type

 How to use: 

 
 Create views with entity type that you want to show 
 it requires 2 fields (1 to display name, 1 for hierachi) 
 if your view with taxonomy add parent field 
 if your view is a user entity you must have a user reference field, add this as a parent field 
 If your view is a node entity, you must have a content reference field, add this as a parent field 
 another field (Title field, Color field, Avatar field) is optional
